title: Compiler stops with Stack overflow in the join of types at -O3
summary: At `-O3` the compiler stops with `Fatal error: exception Stack overflow` on a function that joins closures of two instances of a recursive set. The join of types recurses without end when one side is an alias and the other is not.

actual.text: The compiler stops with `Fatal error: exception Stack overflow`, exit status 2.

cause: `middle_end/flambda2/types/meet_and_join.ml` and `meet_and_n_way_join.ml`: the test for a cycle is made only when both types are aliases.

fix.text: Stops the join from following aliases on one side without end. Builds; `test.ml` then prints the expected result; testsuite unchanged.
